question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Certain
solution:
The correct answer is "**Definite.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Certain" means being completely sure; without any doubts**.

 
 
• Example: I am quite certain that he was the one who called me yesterday.
 
 
 
• **"Definite' means sure or certain, without any doubt.**
 
 
• **​**Example: I am definite that I will pass the exam.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the synonym of 'certain' is 'definite'.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Approval means giving permission or agreement.
 
• Doubtful means uncertain or unsure.
 
• Caution means warning or carefulness.
